assessments.reasoning: The raw 20060411044402 OSI afl-2.1.php capture matches the claimed digest. The v. 2.1 heading and “Licensed under the Academic Free License version 2.1” notice immediately following the work’s copyright notice introduce the numbered grant.

The Index’s pinned license admission rule applies to the identifiable v2.1 text and includes historical editions. Its authority provisions reserve work-specific and external classification questions for separate assessment.

Rosen’s September 2021 statement expressly covers pre-3.0 editions, including v2.1, and Smith proposes a superseded category for legacy uses. Brasseur’s uncertainty about definitive approval proof and Rosen’s retrospective answer leave an edition-specific board action outside this binding.

challenge.method: Tested the exact boundaries of “below version 2.1” and “prior to version 3.0,” then checked the operative body against the previous-version list, sidebar and website footer.
challenge.results: The earlier warning excludes v2.1 and the later cutoff includes it. The difference is explained by date and scope. Neither establishes an individual grant’s invalidation or a board action. The pinned SPDX flag remains false.

limitations: The historical classification records the author’s later treatment for Index purposes. Its legal effect on any work, OSI board history and SPDX identifier status require their own evidence.
reasoning: OSI’s archived v2.1 page identifies an edition-specific software grant. Its contemporary warning applies to versions below 2.1. Rosen’s broader 2021 statement supplies the evidence for treating v2.1 itself as historical.
